properties.description: tools/every_tool_carries_a_title.py reads tools/list from the real binary over stdio and fails when any tool lacks a non-empty title distinct from its name, or any tool with readOnlyHint=false lacks destructiveHint; it refuses to pass on an empty list. Runs in CI after toolsnap.
properties.findings: On the branch binary: 197 tools, 197 titled, 119 of 119 writers with destructiveHint, exit 0. On main's binaries (release 0.81.0 and a fresh debug build of main): exit 1 with 309 problems (197 missing titles, 112 missing hints), observed before any Rust was edited.
properties.name: Every served tool has a title and every writer a destruction hint (gate over the real binary)
